about: Ghostflights' real schedules (ghostflights.tv) for Skyarium's ghost flights, v2 (Skyarium's docs/GHOSTS.md, D301). Exported by the ghostflights repo's tools/export_ghost_bank.py. Don't edit by hand.
rows: [number, from, to, leave (local minutes), offset (minutes the origin's clock is behind UTC), block minutes, days (a bit each, Monday first), starts on, ends after (dates on the airline's calendar), type, arrive (local minutes)]
kept: flights in the air some time between 20:00 and 07:00 at the origin's clock
tails: a type's tails are Skyarium's v1 fleets' (Ghostflights has none); a ghost gets one only where they're listed
